svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Blade: cut 650 mm of 32 x 8 mm flat bar. Grind one end to a point

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 40 long (the full 32 width tapering to the centre). Chamfer the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: struck top end 1 mm so it does not mushroom into sharp burrs.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill a 20.5 mm cross hole on the centre line, 25 mm below the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: top end (pilot 6 mm, then step up; clamp the bar in a vice).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Handle: cut 250 mm of 20 mm round bar; chamfer both ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: handle through the hole, centred; a 20 mm shaft collar each side

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: against the blade, set screws tight on the bar.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark the blade 485 mm up from the point: the stop's top face goes there

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: blade straight within 2 mm; point on the centre line.
